rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child’s short letter of presidential appreciation. Both letters praise cooperation connected with national defense and conclude by asking the addressed chairman or secretary to convey the President’s commendation or appreciation to all members of the relevant group. C14 has a similar relay-of-gratitude formulation, but its subject and structure are less closely aligned. C13 shares appreciation for cooperative defense-related support but lacks the same convey-to-all-members mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I want the members of the Federal Reserve Board and the members of the Federal Open Market Committee to know how deeply I appreciate their expression of full cooperation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The successful completion of this mission is an outstanding example of cooperation between the Agencies responsible for the military defense of the nation
shared_material.explanation: Both frame presidential praise around institutional cooperation serving national defense.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish you would convey to all the members of your group my warm appreciation of their cooperative attitude.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Please convey to the Commander of Join Task Force Seven and to all of the member of the National Military Establishment who contributed to the success of the undertaking my commendation for a job well done.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close parallel operative request: the addressee is asked to relay presidential appreciation or commendation to all members of a contributing group.
